about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Korean Spring Onion and Sesame Pesto
recipes.summary: A punchy no-cook paste of spring onion, toasted sesame and soy, spooned over rice, eggs or noodles.
steps: Blitz the spring onions, sesame seeds and garlic in a food processor until a coarse paste forms.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, vinegar and vegetable oil and pulse until combined but still textured.
Spoon into a jar and serve over rice, noodles or fried eggs.

recipes.title: Korean Soy Spring Onion Dressing
recipes.summary: A thin, savoury-sweet dressing for cold noodles, tofu and steamed greens.
steps: Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil and honey together until the honey dissolves.
Stir in the spring onions, garlic and sesame seeds.
Spoon over noodles, tofu or greens just before serving.

recipes.title: Cold Beetroot Soup Hlodnik
recipes.summary: A bright pink Lithuanian-style chilled soup of beetroot, yoghurt, cucumber and dill, served with a hot potato.
steps: Simmer the grated beetroot in 1 cup water for 15 minutes until tender, then cool completely in the fridge.
Boil the potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes until a knife slides in easily.
Stir the beetroot and its liquid into the yoghurt with the lemon juice and salt until the soup turns bright pink.
Fold in the cucumber, radishes, dill and spring onions and chill until very cold.
Ladle into bowls, top with egg quarters and serve a hot potato alongside.
notes: Food safety: chill the soup within 2 hours of cooking, keep it at 5°C or below and eat within 2 days.
Use thick plant yoghurt thinned with water for dairy-free.

recipes.title: Tomato and Watermelon Gazpacho
recipes.summary: A cold, no-cook soup of ripe tomato, sweet watermelon and cucumber with a little sherry vinegar.
steps: Blend the tomatoes, watermelon, cucumber, capsicum and garlic until completely smooth.
Blend in the olive oil, vinegar and salt until the soup is silky.
Chill for at least 1 hour, taste and adjust the seasoning.
Pour into bowls and scatter with torn mint.

recipes.title: Maple Glazed Roasted Carrots with Thyme
recipes.summary: Whole carrots roasted until caramelised, brushed with maple and thyme.
steps: Toss the carrots with the oil and salt on a large tray until evenly coated.
Roast at 220°C for 25 minutes until tender and browned at the edges.
Stir the maple syrup and butter into the hot tray with the thyme and roast for 8 minutes until the carrots turn glossy and sticky, then serve hot.
notes: Use olive oil instead of butter for vegan.

recipes.title: Honey Roasted Sweet Potato Wedges
recipes.summary: Crisp-edged sweet potato wedges roasted with paprika and a final honey drizzle.

items: 900 g sweet potato, cut into wedges

steps: Toss the wedges with the oil, paprika and salt on a large tray in a single layer.
Roast at 220°C for 30 minutes, turning once, until deep golden and tender inside.
Drizzle with the honey and lemon juice and roast for 5 minutes until sticky.
Scatter with parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Creamed Leeks with Nutmeg
recipes.summary: Soft leeks in a light cream sauce, a quiet side for roast chicken or fish.

items: 4 leeks, white and pale green parts, sliced

steps: Melt the butter with the oil in a wide pan and cook the leeks over medium heat for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the stock, cover and cook for 5 minutes until the leeks are tender.
Stir in the cream, nutmeg and salt and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes until lightly thickened.
Scatter with chives and serve.
notes: Wash the sliced leeks well in a bowl of cold water to remove grit.

recipes.title: Barley Salad with Sultanas and Pecans
recipes.summary: Chewy pearl barley with dried sultanas, toasted pecans, celery and an apple cider dressing.
steps: Simmer the barley in plenty of water for 30 minutes until tender, then drain and cool for 10 minutes.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard and salt together.
Toss the barley with the dressing, sultanas, pecans, celery, spring onions and parsley until evenly coated, then serve warm or cold.

recipes.title: Brown Rice Salad with Mango and Cashews
recipes.summary: Nutty brown rice tossed with ripe mango, cucumber, mint and toasted cashews in a lime dressing.
steps: Simmer the rice in plenty of water for 28 minutes until tender, then drain and spread out to cool.
Whisk the lime juice, oil and soy sauce together.
Toss the cooled rice with the mango, cucumber, cashews, mint, spring onions and dressing until combined.
notes: Food safety: cool the cooked rice and refrigerate within 1 hour, and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Quinoa Salad with Roasted Corn and Black Beans
recipes.summary: Fluffy quinoa with charred corn, black beans, tomato and coriander in a cumin-lime dressing.
steps: Simmer the quinoa in 2 cups water for 15 minutes until the water is absorbed and the grains are tender, then fluff and cool.
Char the corn cobs in a hot dry pan for 10 minutes, turning, until browned in spots, then slice off the kernels.
Whisk the lime juice, oil, cumin and salt together.
Toss the quinoa with the corn, beans, tomatoes, coriander, spring onions and dressing until combined.
notes: Food safety: cool and refrigerate the cooked quinoa within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pearl Couscous Salad with Preserved Lemon
recipes.summary: Toasted pearl couscous with preserved lemon, chickpeas, olives and herbs.
steps: Toast the couscous in a dry pan for 3 minutes until lightly golden.
Boil in salted water for 8 minutes until tender, then drain and cool for 10 minutes.
Toss with the chickpeas, preserved lemon, olives, parsley, mint, oil and lemon juice until combined.
notes: Rinse the preserved lemon rind before chopping to cut the salt.

recipes.title: Black Rice Salad with Edamame and Ginger
recipes.summary: Chewy black rice with edamame, carrot and spring onion in a ginger-soy dressing.
steps: Simmer the black rice in plenty of water for 35 minutes until tender, adding the edamame for the last 4 minutes, then drain and cool.
Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil and ginger together.
Toss the rice and edamame with the carrot, spring onions and dressing until combined.
Scatter with sesame seeds.
notes: Food safety: cool and refrigerate the cooked rice within 1 hour, and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Polish Krupnik Barley Soup
recipes.summary: A thick, homely soup of pearl barley, root vegetables and chicken stock with dill.
steps: Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the butter in a large pot for 8 minutes until softened.
Add the barley, stock and bay leaves and simmer for 25 minutes until the barley is nearly tender.
Add the potatoes and simmer for 15 minutes until soft.
Stir in the salt and dill, remove the bay leaves and ladle into bowls with a spoonful of sour cream.
notes: Thickens on standing, so loosen with water when reheating.

recipes.title: Russian Solyanka Sour Meat Soup
recipes.summary: A tangy, smoky soup of sausage, ham, pickles and olives, finished with lemon and dill.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil in a large pot for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the sausage and ham and cook for 5 minutes until lightly browned, then stir in the tomato paste for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock and diced pickles and simmer for 25 minutes until the flavours are well blended.
Stir in the olives and capers and simmer for 5 minutes until hot.
Serve with lemon slices, dill and a spoonful of sour cream.
notes: Food safety: cool leftovers within 2 hours, refrigerate and reheat until steaming hot at 75°C or above.

recipes.title: Serbian Sopska Salad
recipes.summary: Chopped tomato, cucumber and roasted capsicum under a snow of grated white cheese.
steps: Toss the tomatoes, cucumbers, capsicum and onion with the oil, vinegar and salt until glossy.
Pile onto a platter and cover generously with grated feta.
Scatter with parsley and serve at once.
notes: Traditionally made with sirene, a white brined cheese; feta is a close match.

recipes.title: Bosnian Begova Chicken and Okra Soup
recipes.summary: A creamy chicken and okra soup thickened with a butter and flour roux and finished with lemon.
steps: Simmer the chicken, carrots and onion in the water for 30 minutes until the chicken is cooked through, then lift out the chicken and shred it.
Add the okra to the broth and simmer for 10 minutes until tender.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 2 minutes until pale, then whisk in 1 cup of the hot broth until smooth and stir the mixture back into the pot.
Whisk the egg yolks, cream and lemon juice in a bowl, whisk in a ladle of hot soup, then stir it into the pot off the heat until the soup turns glossy.
Return the chicken, season with the salt and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until the juices run clear and it reaches 75°C, and do not boil after adding the yolks; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Croatian Manestra Bean and Corn Soup
recipes.summary: A rustic Istrian soup of borlotti beans, corn and potato simmered with a little smoked bacon.
steps: Cook the bacon in the oil in a large pot for 5 minutes until it turns golden, then add the onion and garlic and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the tomato paste, then add the beans, corn, potatoes, water and salt.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the soup thickens.
Mash a few beans against the side of the pot, scatter with parsley and serve.
notes: Leave out the bacon for vegetarian and use smoked paprika instead.
Food safety: refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Hungarian Gulyasleves Beef Soup
recipes.summary: The soup cousin of goulash: beef, potato and carrot in a paprika broth.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat for 8 minutes until coloured, then lift out.
Cook the onions in the same pot for 8 minutes until soft, then stir in the garlic, paprika, tomato paste and caraway for 1 minute.
Return the beef, add the water and salt and simmer gently for 1 hour until the beef is tender.
Add the carrots, potatoes and capsicum and simmer for 20 minutes until the vegetables are soft.
notes: Food safety: cool leftovers within 2 hours and reheat until steaming hot at 75°C or above.
Keep the heat low when adding paprika so it does not turn bitter.

recipes.title: Latvian Sauerkraut Salad with Caraway
recipes.summary: A crunchy sauerkraut and carrot salad with onion and caraway, a classic with roast pork and potatoes.
steps: Squeeze the sauerkraut with your hands to remove excess brine.
Toss with the carrots, onion, oil, caraway seeds and honey until evenly coated.
Scatter with parsley and serve cold.
notes: Rinse the sauerkraut briefly if you want it milder.

recipes.title: Georgian Green Bean Salad with Walnuts
recipes.summary: Steamed green beans in a garlicky walnut and coriander dressing, a classic Georgian starter.
steps: Steam the beans for 6 minutes until just tender and bright green, then cool under cold water and drain.
Blitz the walnuts, garlic, coriander leaves, vinegar, ground coriander, salt and water to a thick paste.
Toss the beans in the paste until coated and scatter with pomegranate seeds.

recipes.title: Georgian Ajika Chilli Paste
recipes.summary: A fiery red chilli and garlic paste with walnuts and dried herbs, used by the spoonful.
steps: Blitz the chillies, garlic and walnuts until a coarse paste forms.
Add the coriander, fenugreek, vinegar, oil and salt and blitz until combined.
Pack into a jar and rest in the fridge before serving with grilled meat, bread or beans.
notes: Wear gloves when handling the chillies.

recipes.title: Bulgarian Kyopolou Eggplant Spread
recipes.summary: Smoky charred eggplant blended with roasted capsicum, garlic and walnuts.
steps: Roast the eggplants and capsicums at 230°C for 40 minutes, turning, until the skins blacken and the flesh collapses.
Peel the vegetables and drain the eggplant flesh for 5 minutes.
Mash the flesh with the garlic, walnuts, oil, vinegar and salt until chunky.
Spoon into a bowl and top with parsley.
notes: Serve with bread or grilled meat.

recipes.title: Hungarian Cucumber Salad with Paprika
recipes.summary: Paper-thin cucumber in a sweet-sour dressing with garlic, sour cream and a dusting of paprika.
steps: Toss the cucumber slices with the salt and drain in a colander for 10 minutes, then squeeze out the water.
Whisk the vinegar, sugar, garlic and sour cream together until smooth.
Toss through the cucumber and dust with paprika.
notes: Serve straight away so the cucumber stays crisp.

recipes.title: Russian Vinegret Beetroot Salad
recipes.summary: A ruby salad of diced beetroot, potato, carrot and pickles in sunflower oil.
steps: Boil the beetroot, potatoes and carrots in their skins for 35 minutes until a knife slides in easily, then cool and peel.
Dice everything into 1 cm cubes.
Toss with the pickles, sauerkraut, onion, oil and salt, stirring the beetroot in last so the colour does not bleed.
Chill and scatter with dill.
